offer.product: Whey Protein Concentrate with Vitamin D3 and B12 (with lecithin)
offer.basis: Exact official retail pack and ordinary INR listed price reviewed on 20 November 2026. Nutrition values are manufacturer declarations, not independent assay results. Trustified was used for discovery; a report on another batch or product does not certify this listing.
offer.notes: Exact manufacturer SKU OWNAPP.00041 and product URL were matched to the explicit ProductGroup variant. Current unflavoured formula declares 76.47 g protein/100g and a 34 g scoop, enriched with 1.13 mcg vitamin B12 and 7.73 mcg vitamin D3 per scoop. Those added nutrients must be included when reviewing a combined stack. Contains milk and up to0.7% soy lecithin. Actual 1 kg retail pack. Unrelated copied hair-loss metadata in the website state was ignored; only matching product name,SKU,variant and reviewed panel were used.
offer.productReviewReason: Fortified whey contains vitamins D3 and B12; review cumulative micronutrient exposure before stack inclusion.
